notes: Keys are 事業者名:路線名 exactly as in unkohonsu2026_rosen_kukan.txt; operators is the fallback for a line with no entry.

Values are the operators' official line colours (signage and station-numbering colours), not train liveries or corporate colours; lines sharing a numbering group share its colour. The two source notes below say which hexes are the operator's own and which are approximate; 京浜急行電鉄 is the one deliberate exception.

Readability rule: a colour under 3:1 contrast against the #07080c background (the WCAG non-text minimum) is lightened in HSL to lightness 45%, then in 1% steps until it reaches 3:1; hue and saturation are kept.

Lightened: 東急電鉄:東急多摩川線 #AE0378 -> #E2049C (contrast 2.9:1 -> 4.5:1); 横浜高速鉄道:みなとみらい21線 #09357F -> #0F59D6 (contrast 1.7:1 -> 3.3:1); 京王電鉄:井の頭線 #2E3192 -> #4D50C7 (contrast 1.9:1 -> 3.1:1); 東武鉄道:東上本線, 東武鉄道:越生線 #004098 -> #0061E6 (contrast 2.1:1 -> 3.7:1); 京成電鉄:本線, 京成電鉄:押上線, 京成電鉄:金町線, 京成電鉄:千葉線, 京成電鉄:松戸線 #005AAA -> #0079E6 (contrast 2.9:1 -> 4.6:1); 相模鉄道:本線, 相模鉄道:いずみ野線, 相模鉄道:相鉄新横浜線 #0B3B8C -> #115AD5 (contrast 1.9:1 -> 3.3:1); 東京臨海高速鉄道:りんかい線 #00418E -> #0069E6 (contrast 2.0:1 -> 4.0:1); 東急電鉄:新横浜線 #890D84 -> #D214CA (contrast 2.3:1 -> 4.5:1); 埼玉高速鉄道:埼玉高速鉄道線 #2351A5 -> #285DBD (contrast 2.7:1 -> 3.2:1); ゆりかもめ:東京臨海新交通臨海線 and the ゆりかもめ fallback #27404E -> #4D7E99 (contrast 1.8:1 -> 4.5:1); JR西日本:桜島線 #1D2D6F -> #3552CA (contrast 1.6:1 -> 3.1:1); JR西日本:関西空港線 #0E4D9E -> #1367D3 (contrast 2.5:1 -> 3.7:1); 大阪市高速電気軌道:谷町線 #522886 -> #783BC4 (contrast 1.9:1 -> 3.1:1); 大阪市高速電気軌道:堺筋線 #814721 -> #B7652F (contrast 2.7:1 -> 4.7:1); 能勢電鉄:妙見線, 能勢電鉄:日生線 #7D1F2E -> #B82E44 (contrast 2.0:1 -> 3.3:1); 阪神電気鉄道:本線, 阪神電気鉄道:武庫川線 #00468C -> #0073E6 (contrast 2.1:1 -> 4.4:1); 京阪電気鉄道:京阪本線, 京阪電気鉄道:鴨東線, 京阪電気鉄道:中之島線, 京阪電気鉄道:宇治線, 京阪電気鉄道:交野線 #1E50A2 -> #2460C2 (contrast 2.6:1 -> 3.4:1).
Hibiya silver #B5B5AC already reads at about 10:1 on #07080c and is kept as is.

Toei: 三田線 #0079C2, 大江戸線 #B6007A, 日暮里・舎人線 #F7A1C0 and 荒川線 #E46FA2 replace the colours in Toei's own GTFS (三田線 0067B0, 大江戸線 CF3366, blank for the liner and the tram) in toei_train_shaped; 浅草線 #FF535F and 新宿線 #9FB01C are Toei's own values, so the shaped feed keeps them unchanged.

Official (the operator's own published values): 東京都:新宿線 #9FB01C (leaf green) and 東京都:浅草線 #FF535F (rose), from Toei's GTFS (toei_train.zip routes.txt) and the matching ODPT odpt:Railway record; they replace older #6CBB5A and #E85298, and the 東京都 operator fallback follows 新宿線 as before. Official hue, approximate hex (the operator names the colour; the hex is a dataset's station-numbering badge): 阪急電鉄 by line group, Kobe 神戸線, 今津線, 甲陽線, 伊丹線, 神戸高速線 #007AC4 blue (also the operator fallback), Takarazuka 宝塚線, 箕面線 #F26627 orange, Kyoto 京都線, 千里線, 嵐山線 #2A9B50 green, hues from Hankyu's official X account (神戸線はブルー, 宝塚線はオレンジ, 京都線はグリーン), hexes from TrainLCD StationAPI (maroon #741C27 is the train livery and is gone); 叡山電鉄:叡山本線 #007F00 green (also the operator fallback) and 鞍馬線 #FF0000 red, hues from Eiden's station guide, hexes from TrainLCD and ekimemo; 京福電気鉄道:嵐山本線 (A) #D7003A red (also the operator fallback) and 北野線 (B) #5654A2 kikyō blue-violet, Randen's 2007 line colours, hexes from the ekimemo station_database (the 京紫 purple #7B2E7E is the train livery); 京成電鉄:松戸線 Keisei blue #005AAA as for the other KS lines, since the line joined Keisei and its KS numbering on 2025-04-01 (the Shin-Keisei pink #EF5BA1 is defunct); ゆりかもめ blue-grey (ブルーグレー) #27404E from Mini Tokyo 3D and ekimemo, lightened, replacing sky blue #1E9BD7.

Approximate (secondary sources only; they agree on the hue, but the hex is not checked against a sign manual): 近畿日本鉄道 by numbering letter, from the English Wikipedia infobox map colours, A/G 難波線・奈良線, 生駒線 #C22047 (also the operator fallback), B/H/I 京都線, 橿原線, 天理線, 田原本線 #E7A61A amber, C けいはんな線 #65C03A, D/J 大阪線, 信貴線 #2E89D9 light blue (the 信貴線 infobox value; TrainLCD gives D/J #4694D1), F/N/O/P 南大阪線・吉野線, 道明寺線, 長野線, 御所線 #008446 green (TrainLCD and ekimemo give the same hue families); JR西日本:おおさか東線 #4D6C82 slate blue (Wikipedia JR West numbering template; rmg-palette #447694, ekimemo #347293); JR西日本:和歌山線 #F5A2BA pink (rmg-palette; ekimemo #F79FBA); JR西日本:山陰線 (Sagano) #7585C1 blue-violet (rmg-palette; ekimemo #878DDC); 東急電鉄:新横浜線 #890D84 purple (TrainLCD, and nicovideo citing Tokyu's station pages), lightened; 西武鉄道:国分寺線 and 西武園線 (SK) #38B35C green, 多摩川線 (SW) #F17C24 orange, 山口線 (SY) #EC4840 red (rmg-palette; Mini Tokyo 3D, ekimemo and TrainLCD agree on the hues); 埼玉高速鉄道:埼玉高速鉄道線 #2351A5 blue (Mini Tokyo 3D, nicovideo; rmg-palette #3564AF, TrainLCD #3565AD), lightened, replacing teal #00A6A0 that read as Namboku continuing. JR西日本:桜井線 #C1272D agrees with rmg-palette and ekimemo (wine red) and is unchanged.

Keikyu exception: 京浜急行電鉄 (本線, 空港線, 大師線, and through the operator fallback 久里浜線 and 逗子線) keeps #E8334A, which is Keikyu's brand and train red, not its line colour. The official KK numbering colour is deep sky blue (#00BFFF in rmg-palette and ekimemo), but that is only CIEDE2000 4.6 from JR東日本:京浜東北・根岸線 at its official #00B2E5, which runs within about 300 m of Keikyu for most of Shinagawa to Yokohama, so the two would draw as one line; the red stays apart from it.

Close pairs kept because each line wears its own colour and they are told apart by position: 阪急電鉄:神戸線 #007AC4 and JR西日本:東海道線 #0072BC (CIEDE2000 3.1) run parallel 1 to 2 km apart between Osaka and Kobe; 阪急電鉄:京都線 #2A9B50 crosses 京都市:烏丸線 #3CB371 (8.0) at right angles at Shijo-Karasuma; 近畿日本鉄道:南大阪線・吉野線 #008446 and JR西日本:関西線 #00A85A (12.2) both leave Tennoji to the south-east.
